title: Understanding Bernoulli Sampling
text: Bernoulli sampling involves selecting each row independently with a certain probability. This means that each row has an equal chance of being included in the sample. Think about how this might affect the representation of the entire dataset.

title: Exploring the LIMIT Clause
text: The LIMIT clause in SQL is used to restrict the number of rows returned by a query. Consider how this might impact the randomness and representativeness of the sample compared to Bernoulli sampling.

title: Evaluating Bias in Sampling
text: Which of the following statements is true about using the LIMIT clause for sampling?
choices: It always provides an unbiased sample
It is equivalent to Bernoulli sampling
